problem.title: You opened a business, not a marketing agency.
problem.card1Text: You open up, serve customers, chase suppliers and close the till. There's no time left to post, so your page goes quiet for weeks.
problem.card2Text: HubSpot, Hootsuite and the rest assume you already have followers, a budget and someone who knows marketing.

tutorials.title: Phone photo tips
tutorials.subtitle: Angles that work for a <1>{{category}}</1>, step by step

cafe.step1Tip: Hold your phone at 45 degrees and pan slowly. Zoom to 2x so the cup stays sharp and the background goes soft.
cafe.step2Tip: Shoot near your biggest window between 4:00 and 5:30 PM, and let the daylight catch the edges of cups and pastries.
cafe.step3Tip: Stand at the corner of a booth. Put an open laptop with code or a design on screen next to a fresh cappuccino, so it looks like a real workday.

beauty.step1Tip: Put a ring light right in front of the client. Focus on a clean haircut line, or shoot lashes up close at 3x zoom.
beauty.step2Tip: Seat the client in the same chair, head at the same angle, so the two shots line up side by side.

generic.step1Tip: Get close to the detail customers love most about your {{category}}. Use 2x zoom, keep the subject sharp and let the background blur softly.
generic.step2Tip: Shoot near your biggest window between 4:00 and 5:30 PM, so warm daylight catches the edges of your {{category}} space.
generic.step3Tip: Catch a real moment of a customer or someone on your team enjoying your {{category}}. Faces and movement beat an empty room.

steps: Open Telegram and start a chat with @BotFather.

requirements: An Instagram Professional account (Business or Creator)
That account linked to a Facebook Page you administer
A photo or video for every post — Instagram has no text-only post
steps: In the Instagram app: Settings → Account type → switch to Business or Creator.
Still in Instagram settings, link the account to your Facebook Page.
Press Connect here and sign in with that Facebook account.
Tick both the Page and the linked Instagram account on the permissions screen.
Press Connect here and log in with your Facebook account.
Select the Facebook Page you want Markivo to post to.
Tick all permissions so Markivo can draft and publish posts.

requirements: A Google Business Profile listing for your business
The listing VERIFIED by Google (postcard, phone, or email)
Owner or manager access on the Google account you sign in with
steps: Claim your listing at business.google.com if you have not already.
Finish Google’s verification — unverified listings cannot receive posts.
Press Connect and sign in with the Google account that owns the listing.
Approve the Business Profile permission, then pick the location to post to.

audienceLanguages.label: Which languages do your customers read?
audienceLanguages.hint: Every caption, script and on-screen line is written in these, in the order you pick them.

brandTone.label: How should your brand sound?
brandTone.hint: Sets the voice of every caption Markivo writes for you.

signatureItems.label: What do regulars ask for by name?
signatureItems.hint: Your signature items give posts something specific to show.

hours.label: When are you open?
hours.hint: So posts never send someone to a closed door.

pricePoints.label: What does a typical order or visit cost?
pricePoints.hint: Without this, Markivo has to write around prices. It never makes one up.

bookingLink.label: Where should a post send people to book or order?
bookingLink.hint: We put it at the end of your captions, so people know where to go.
bookingLink.placeholder: e.g. t.me/yourshop, a website link, or your phone number

slogan.label: Do you already have a slogan?
slogan.hint: If you have one, we'll use it instead of writing a new one.

profileQuestions.saveError: We couldn't save your answers. Please try again.

busiest_hours.label: When is the place busiest, and when is it quiet?
busiest_hours.hint: We schedule posts into the quiet hours you want to fill.

seating_setup.label: What is the room like to sit in?
seating_setup.hint: The detail that makes a photo caption specific to you.
seating_setup.placeholder: e.g. 6 tables, a long window bar, power at every seat

beans_or_supplier.label: Where do your beans or ingredients come from?
beans_or_supplier.hint: Sourcing is a story competitors cannot copy.
beans_or_supplier.placeholder: e.g. roasted locally, Ethiopian single origin

top_service.label: Which service do you most want to be booked for?
top_service.hint: We push this one instead of spreading posts thin.

appointment_length.label: How long does a typical appointment take?
appointment_length.hint: Lets posts set the right expectation before someone books.
appointment_length.placeholder: e.g. 90 minutes for colour, 30 for a trim

master_names.label: Who are the masters clients ask for by name?
master_names.hint: Named people outperform anonymous salon photos.

membership_options.label: How can someone use the space — by hour, day, or month?
membership_options.hint: The first thing a prospective member wants to know.
membership_options.placeholder: e.g. hourly, day pass, monthly desk

quiet_rules.label: What are the rules on noise, calls, and meeting rooms?
quiet_rules.hint: Answers the objection that stops people booking.
quiet_rules.placeholder: e.g. calls only in booths, 2 meeting rooms

amenities.label: What is included that people actually notice?
amenities.placeholder: e.g. 200 Mbps, free coffee, printer, lockers

restock_rhythm.label: How often does new stock arrive?
restock_rhythm.hint: New arrivals are the easiest recurring post you have.
restock_rhythm.placeholder: e.g. a new drop every second Friday

size_range.label: What sizes or variants do you carry?
size_range.hint: Stops us writing a post that disappoints a buyer.

return_policy.label: What is your exchange or return policy?
return_policy.hint: Removes the hesitation before a first purchase.
return_policy.placeholder: e.g. exchange within 7 days with the receipt

signature_dish_story.label: Which dish would you want a first-time guest to order?
signature_dish_story.hint: One dish, repeated, is what makes a place recognisable.
signature_dish_story.placeholder: e.g. the lamb plov, cooked to order

delivery_setup.label: How do people order for delivery or pickup, if you offer it?
delivery_setup.hint: We only mention delivery if you actually do it.
delivery_setup.placeholder: e.g. Telegram orders, pickup only after 21:00

group_capacity.label: Can you take groups or events, and how large?
group_capacity.hint: Group bookings are the highest-value post you can run.
group_capacity.placeholder: e.g. up to 20 people with a day of notice

core_service.label: What kind of project do you want more of?
core_service.hint: Aims every post at the work you actually want.
core_service.placeholder: e.g. mobile apps for local retailers

project_timeline.label: How long does a typical engagement run?
project_timeline.hint: Sets expectations before the first call.
project_timeline.placeholder: e.g. 6-8 weeks from brief to launch

proof_point.label: What result can you point to from past work?
proof_point.hint: A concrete outcome is the only proof that travels.
proof_point.placeholder: e.g. cut a client checkout from 5 steps to 2

best_seller.label: What do customers come back for most often?
best_seller.hint: The one thing worth repeating across your posts.

how_to_buy.label: How does a customer actually buy from you?
how_to_buy.hint: Becomes the call to action on every post.
how_to_buy.placeholder: e.g. walk in, or message us on Telegram

one_difference.label: What do you do that nearby businesses do not?
one_difference.hint: Without this, posts default to generic praise.
one_difference.placeholder: e.g. we roast on site every morning

publish.title: Post this to your channels
publish.noneConnected: No channels connected yet. Connect one in Connections to post.
publish.loggedSimulated: Saved, but not posted. It goes live once this channel is connected.

brand.title: Your brand
brand.subtitle: The brand brief Markiv reads before every post, caption and design, so it all sounds like you.
brand.emptyBody: No brand brief yet. Markiv can write one from your business profile: where you fit in the market, how you sound, who you serve, what to post about and how it should look.
brand.factsHelp: Add your real details so Markiv can write specific, true posts. It never makes up prices, hours or numbers you haven't given.
brand.factsSaved: Saved. Markiv will use these details and never make up others.
brand.signaturePh: e.g. cardamom bun, flat white, beard trim

errors.network: We can't reach Markivo right now. Check your internet connection and try again.
errors.requestFailed: Something went wrong ({{status}}). Please try again.
